\noindent\footnotesize Each cell compares generated-library \AC\ leading-colour production against \PAC\ staged-DAG JIT O3 and C++ O3 at the same final-state multiplicity \(n\).  Cell slots are \AC, \PAC\ JIT, and \PAC\ C++ O3; each slot shows generation time above runtime per phase-space point.  \PAC\ runtime multipliers are \texttt{(wall|core)} relative to \AC.  If no direct \AC\ reference exists, completed \PAC\ slots show absolute timings. Generation materializes all LC colour orderings.  Runtime timings use the first generated-library \AC\ group/integral and the matching \PAC\ LC colour sector, mirroring the AmpliCol phase-space integrator which evaluates one selected flow per sample point. Ratio colours are green below one, orange below two, and red otherwise.  The summary rows give \texttt{min|max|avg|med}; multiplier summaries add \texttt{sum}, the ratio of paired summed \PAC\ and \AC\ times.  Missing and structural N/A cells are ignored.  Validated rows use the same phase-space point and a \(10^{-8}\) relative tolerance.
\par\smallskip
\noindent\footnotesize A red \textbf{VALIDATION FAILED} marker is shown next to any validated entry whose relative difference exceeds \(10^{-8}\).

\paragraph{Matrix run settings.}
\noindent\footnotesize Generated by \path{docs/result_matrix.py} with \texttt{--color-accuracy lc}, from \path{result_matrix_data.json} into \path{result_matrix_table.tex}. \AC\ uses the full \texttt{processes.txt} with \texttt{amplicol\_generate --library=create}, \texttt{make amplicol\_generate\_library}, and a direct generated-library timing of the first group/integral.  \PAC\ generation uses \texttt{--lc-sector-strategy all}; \texttt{time-process} selects the matching LC sector at runtime. \PAC\ uses Rusticol double precision, batch size 64, output chunk size 128, stage-local evaluator inputs, ten Horner iterations, Symbolica's default CPE iteration choice, and enlarged Horner/common-pair limits.  JIT rows use SymJIT \(\mathrm{O}3\); timing runs use \texttt{--target-runtime 10}.  Only C++ O3 generation is subject to the 15-minute compile cap.
\par\smallskip
\paragraph{Structural reference limitations.}
The four-quark-line row \(d\bar d\to u\bar u\,s\bar s\,c\bar c+(n-6)g\), is a structural \AC\ N/A: the current Fortran path stops above its supported quark-line count.  Completed \PAC\ cells are shown as absolute timings.
\par\smallskip
\paragraph{C++ O3 compile-budget gaps.}
These cells have completed \AC\ and \PAC\ JIT rows but no completed C++ O3 row: $d\bar d\to Z+(n-1)g$, \(n=6\): not run; $d\bar d\to Z+(n-1)g$, \(n=7\): not run; $d\bar d\to Z+(n-1)g$, \(n=8\): not run; $u\bar d\to W^++(n-1)g$, \(n=6\): not run; $u\bar d\to W^++(n-1)g$, \(n=7\): not run; $u\bar d\to W^++(n-1)g$, \(n=8\): not run; $d\bar d\to e^+e^-+(n-2)g$, \(n=6\): not run; $d\bar d\to e^+e^-+(n-2)g$, \(n=7\): not run; plus 31 more localized entries.
